## 40 · Reference — Hourly onboarding via EFX (inactive, STAGING only)
Event-driven rebuild of George's *Employee Onboarding (Hourly / Salary Branch)* draft. Everything that was blocked on "the employee number isn't in the email" is solved by the `result` event: **`internalEmployeeId` is final at Initial Request submit.**

Flow: poll `n8n_events` (kinds `result`, sources `submitInitialRequest`) → one item per new hire → **Hourly only** → map title → SiteDocs *Create Worker* (George's node shape) → Litmos: find manager → *Create User* → **Forms · Submit ID Setup** (`siteDocsWorkerId`, `siteDocsJobCode`, `dssUsername`, generated `dssPassword`, **no internalEmployeeId**) → Forms advances to HR Verification and sends its own emails. Salary hires end in a NoOp stub.

**Placeholders:** `<<ROUTER_WORKFLOW_ID>>`, `<<SUBMIT_ID_SETUP_WORKFLOW_ID>>` (imported 11), credentials `SiteDocs API (<<TIER>>)` and `DSS (Litmos) API (<<TIER>>)` (HTTP Header Auth — George's existing "Site doc's POC" / "DSS (Litmos) API" on staging), `<<LITMOS_TEAM_ID>>` optional.
Every external node is *On Error → Continue (error output)* → **one Gmail to dbinns** (placeholder recipient until approved). Static-data cursor persists only when the workflow is **active**. Swap the first three nodes for the *Apps Script Router Trigger* community node once installed.

parameters.content: **Router: n8n_events** — the Execution API call. `kinds:['result']` + `sources:['submitInitialRequest']` are filtered server-side, so only post-mint Initial Request events come back. `Normalise event` splits `employeeName` into first/last (call *Forms · Get Workflow* if you need exact names) and carries `internalEmployeeId`, `siteName`, `positionTitle`, `hireDate`, `managerEmail`.

**Map title codes** — George's 2026-09-11 SiteDocs scheme (HRLY-U/HRLY, Site-Sup – Union/Site-Sup; union defaults to true until the portal sends it) **plus** the Forms `siteDocsJobCode` (Hourly 1 / Supervisor) that ID Setup requires. Unknown titles throw → error email.

**SiteDocs: Create Worker** — George's exact node (mw4aXq7lq5W1EQBy), with `EmployeeNumber` now the real `internalEmployeeId`. Response `id`/`Id` becomes Forms `siteDocsWorkerId`. Location assignment / QR certification steps from his draft can be inserted after this node unchanged (they read `$('SiteDocs: Create Worker')`).

**Litmos** — find the manager (search by the event's `managerEmail`; George prefers name-matching — swap the query if needed), then **Build DSS user + password**: username = initials + hireDate + site abbrev (George's confirmed scheme); password is **generated per run** (`crypto.randomBytes` when `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto`, else Math.random fallback) and only ever sent to Litmos and to Forms. Then **Litmos: Create User** (`IsCustomUsername=true`, `ExternalEmployeeId = internalEmployeeId`).

parameters.content: **Forms · Submit ID Setup** (sub-workflow 11) — the write-back. Sends exactly the r2 `id_setup` required keys; **no `internalEmployeeId`** (Forms uses the pre-assigned one). Forms then appends *ID Setup Results*, moves the step to "HR Verification Needed" and emails HR itself — no Gmail node needed here. `idempotencyKey` per workflow makes a re-run within 10 min a no-op.
